notes: The seat service is the same as in the standard task; the tools only carry its calls (the HTTP calls the `game` command makes). Locating the ball or the opponent is done by eye in the tile images, with the cameras' intrinsics and poses from `spec`.

patch.notes: Turn-based: nothing moves while you think; your chess clock runs on your turn. `spec` (its file) has the phrase table; `status` / `observe` have every phrase so far.

patch.unsupported: the player delivers Python skill code that the platform runs in the loop (/app/output/skill/); tool calls cannot deliver it
joint-level control (leg or whole-body joint targets every 10-20 ms) needs a running controller program
rod commands at 100 Hz against a ball at up to 5 m/s: thousands of observe/act/wait cycles, more than the model time a trial has
